it-piemonte.varieties: Regional catch-all DOC. Piemonte bianco: Cortese, Chardonnay, Favorita and/or Erbaluce at least 60%. Rosso: Barbera, Nebbiolo, Dolcetto, Freisa and/or Croatina at least 60%. Varietal wines (Barbera, Albarossa, Bonarda, Brachetto, Moscato, Cortese, Chardonnay, Pinot Nero, Grignolino, Freisa and others) normally at least 85% of the named grape; two-variety labels allowed.
it-piemonte.min_alcohol: Natural potential 9.5% (whites, spumante) to 12% (Albarossa); total at release from 10% upwards; passito types 15-16% total.
it-piemonte.max_yield: 11 to 14 t/ha by type (bianco and Cortese 14 t, rosso 13 t, Barbera 12 t, Albarossa 9 t); wine 70-75% of grape weight (e.g. bianco 10,500 l/ha, rosso 9,100 l/ha).
it-piemonte.styles: White, red, rosé; frizzante; spumante (incl. Pinot-Chardonnay); passito; Moscato and Brachetto sweet styles; Cortese with additional geographical unit Marengo.
it-piemonte.labelling: Qualifiers such as superiore, riserva, vecchio, extra are banned; no commune or vigna names. Piemonte must precede the variety or colour on the label.
it-piemonte.other: Used as the fallback for declassified Piedmont DOC/DOCG wine (Piedmont has no IGT).

it-monferrato.ageing: Monferrato Nebbiolo 12 months; Nebbiolo Superiore 18 months incl. 6 in wood, both from 1 November of the harvest year.
it-monferrato.styles: White, Chiaretto rosé, red (also Novello), Dolcetto, Freisa, Nebbiolo (also Superiore), Casalese Cortese.
it-monferrato.labelling: Casalese may not be printed larger than Monferrato; colour statement optional for bianco/rosso; riserva, vecchio etc. banned.

it-asti.labelling: Subzones Santa Vittoria d'Alba and Strevi (Canelli left in 2023 to become its own DOCG). Vintage mandatory except sparkling. Collective consortium mark obligatory. Metodo Martinotti may be stated for tank-method wines; disgorgement date allowed for metodo classico.

it-riviera-ligure-di-ponente.varieties: Pigato at least 95%; Vermentino at least 95%; Rossese at least 90%; Granaccia (Alicante) at least 90%; Moscato 100% Moscato Bianco.

it-riviera-ligure-di-ponente.max_yield: Pigato and Vermentino 11 t/ha, 77 hl/ha (superiore 9 t/ha, 63 hl/ha); Rossese and Granaccia 9 t/ha, 63 hl/ha; Moscato 10 t/ha; passito 50% of grapes.
it-riviera-ligure-di-ponente.ageing: Passito and passito liquoroso released from 1 November of the year after harvest; grapes dried naturally to at least 260 g/l sugar.
it-riviera-ligure-di-ponente.styles: Dry whites (Pigato, Vermentino), reds (Rossese, Granaccia), Moscato (also frizzante, vendemmia tardiva), superiore and passito versions.
it-riviera-ligure-di-ponente.labelling: Subzones Riviera dei Fiori, Albenganese, Finalese, Quiliano and Taggia. Vintage mandatory.

it-portofino.varieties: Bianco: Vermentino and/or Bianchetta Genovese at least 60%. Rosso/rosato: Ciliegiolo and/or Dolcetto at least 60%. Varietal Bianchetta Genovese, Vermentino, Ciliegiolo, Moscato, Scimiscià (Cimixa).
it-portofino.min_alcohol: Natural potential 9.5% whites, 10% reds and rosés; total at release 10.5-12%.
it-portofino.release: Passito from 1 November of the year after harvest.
it-portofino.styles: White (also spumante, frizzante, passito), red (also frizzante, novello), rosé, varietal wines, Moscato passito.
it-portofino.labelling: Golfo del Tigullio-Portofino or Portofino; subzone Costa dei Fieschi. Vintage mandatory except frizzante and spumante.

it-colli-di-luni.varieties: Rosso: Sangiovese at least 50%. Bianco: Vermentino at least 35%, Trebbiano Toscano 25-40%. Vermentino at least 90%; Albarola at least 85%.
it-colli-di-luni.min_alcohol: Natural potential 10.5% (bianco, Albarola), 11% (rosso, Vermentino), 11.5% (Vermentino superiore), 12% (rosso riserva); total at release 11-12.5%.
it-colli-di-luni.ageing: Rosso riserva at least 2 years from 1 November of the harvest year.
it-colli-di-luni.styles: Vermentino (also superiore), Albarola, white, red (also riserva).

it-val-polcevera.varieties: Whites: Vermentino, Bianchetta Genovese, Albarola at least 60%. Reds/rosés: Dolcetto, Sangiovese, Ciliegiolo at least 60%. Varietal Bianchetta Genovese and Vermentino at least 85%.
it-val-polcevera.min_alcohol: Natural potential 9.5% (bianco) to 10.5% (Coronata); total at release 10-11%.
it-val-polcevera.max_yield: 9.5 t/ha (Coronata 9 t/ha); wine 70%, 66.5 hl/ha; passito 50%, 47.5 hl/ha.
it-val-polcevera.styles: White (also spumante, frizzante, passito with grapes dried to 260 g/l), red (also novello with at least 40% carbonic maceration, frizzante), rosé.
it-val-polcevera.labelling: Subzone Coronata (whites). Vintage mandatory except frizzante and spumante.

it-pornassio.max_yield: 9 t/ha (Superiore 8.1 t/ha); wine 70%, 63 hl/ha; passito 50%, 45 hl/ha.
it-pornassio.styles: Red, Superiore, Sciac-trà (rosé), passito, passito liquoroso (fortified).

it-rossese-di-dolceacqua.release: Superiore from 1 November of the year after harvest.
it-rossese-di-dolceacqua.labelling: Rossese di Dolceacqua or Dolceacqua. Vintage mandatory.
it-rossese-di-dolceacqua.other: Bottling must take place in the zone (confirmed in the single document in 2025, EU notice C/2025/5231).

it-cinque-terre.varieties: Bosco, Albarola and/or Vermentino at least 80%; up to 20% other white Ligurian varieties.
it-cinque-terre.min_alcohol: Natural potential 10.5% (subzones 11%); Sciacchetrà grapes dried to at least 19% potential. Total at release 11-11.5%; Sciacchetrà 19%, Riserva 20%.
it-cinque-terre.max_yield: 9 t/ha (subzones 8.5 t/ha); wine 70%, 63 hl/ha (subzones 59.5 hl/ha); Sciacchetrà 32%, 28.8 hl/ha.
it-cinque-terre.ageing: Sciacchetrà grapes partially dried after harvest; vinification not before 1 October of the harvest year.
it-cinque-terre.release: Sciacchetrà from 1 October of the year after harvest; Sciacchetrà Riserva from 1 October of the third year after harvest.
it-cinque-terre.styles: Dry white; Cinque Terre Sciacchetrà (sweet passito) and Sciacchetrà Riserva.
it-cinque-terre.labelling: Subzones Costa de Sera, Costa de Campu, Costa da Posa.

it-colline-di-levanto.varieties: Bianco: Vermentino at least 40%, Albarola at least 20%, Bosco at least 5%. Vermentino at least 85%. Rosso/novello: Sangiovese at least 30%, Ciliegiolo at least 20%.
it-colline-di-levanto.max_yield: 9 t/ha and at most 2.5 kg per vine; wine 70%.
it-colline-di-levanto.sweetness: Whites at most 10 g/l residual sugar.

src.title: MASAF, disciplinare di produzione "Colline di Levanto" (last amended 07.03.2014)

it-riviera-del-garda-bresciano.varieties: Rosso, rosso superiore, Chiaretto: Groppello (Gentile, Mocasina, S. Stefano) at least 30%, plus Marzemino, Barbera, Sangiovese (each max 25%) and other reds. Bianco: Riesling (Italico and/or Renano) at least 50%.
it-riviera-del-garda-bresciano.min_alcohol: Natural potential 10% (bianco), 10.5% (rosso, Chiaretto, Groppello), 11% (rosso superiore); total at release 11-12%.
it-riviera-del-garda-bresciano.max_yield: 12 t/ha (rosso superiore 11 t/ha); wine 70%. Valtènesi subzone 11 t/ha.
it-riviera-del-garda-bresciano.ageing: Valtènesi Riserva at least 2 years from 1 November.
it-riviera-del-garda-bresciano.release: Valtènesi rosso from 1 September after the harvest; Valtènesi Chiaretto from 14 February after the harvest (shipping from 1 February).
it-riviera-del-garda-bresciano.styles: Chiaretto (rosé, the flagship), red, rosso superiore, Groppello, white, rosé spumante (tank or metodo classico).
it-riviera-del-garda-bresciano.labelling: Registered name Riviera del Garda Classico (the former Riviera del Garda Bresciano). Chiaretto mandatory for the still rosé; the spumante must say rosé, not Chiaretto. Subzone Valtènesi (rosso, also Riserva, and Chiaretto). Vintage mandatory except spumante.
it-riviera-del-garda-bresciano.other: 2024 amendment (Reg. (EU) 2024/1868) folded Valtènesi in as a subzone; the separate Valtènesi PDO was then cancelled in 2026.

it-valtenesi.varieties: Valtènesi subzone of Riviera del Garda Classico: Groppello (Gentile, Mocasina, S. Stefano) at least 30%; Marzemino, Barbera, Sangiovese up to 70% (each max 25%).
it-valtenesi.ageing: Riserva at least 2 years from 1 November.
it-valtenesi.release: Rosso from 1 September after the harvest; Chiaretto from 14 February after the harvest.
it-valtenesi.styles: Valtènesi rosso (also Riserva) and Valtènesi Chiaretto.
it-valtenesi.labelling: Now labelled as Riviera del Garda Classico Valtènesi.
it-valtenesi.other: The stand-alone Valtènesi PDO was cancelled at the request of the Consorzio Valtènesi by Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/572 of 17 March 2026; the name survives as a subzone of Riviera del Garda Classico.

it-lambrusco-mantovano.styles: Red and rosé frizzante, dry or amabile.

it-valtellina-rosso.other: Ageing may be authorised in Brusio and Poschiavo (Switzerland).

it-valtellina-superiore.labelling: Subzones Maroggia, Sassella, Grumello, Inferno, Valgella; may add Nebbiolo or Chiavennasca; vigna allowed.
it-valtellina-superiore.other: Steep terraced slopes of the Adda valley (Sondrio); ageing may be authorised in Brusio and Poschiavo (Switzerland). DOCG 1998.

it-sforzato-di-valtellina.varieties: Nebbiolo (Chiavennasca) at least 90%, from dried grapes.
it-sforzato-di-valtellina.min_alcohol: Natural potential 11% at harvest and 14% after drying; total at release 14%.
it-sforzato-di-valtellina.max_yield: 8,000 kg/ha of grapes for drying; wine at most 40 hl/ha of fresh grapes.
it-sforzato-di-valtellina.ageing: Dried grapes vinified from 1 December; at least 20 months incl. 12 in wood, counted from 1 April after the harvest.
it-sforzato-di-valtellina.labelling: Sforzato di Valtellina or Sfursat di Valtellina.
it-sforzato-di-valtellina.other: DOCG 2003; the first dry red from dried grapes to become a DOCG.

it-bonarda-dell-oltrepo-pavese.labelling: Superiore, riserva and similar terms banned; vintage mandatory.

Varietal types (Barbera, Riesling, Cortese, Moscato, Malvasia, Pinot Nero vinified white or rosé, Chardonnay, Sauvignon, Cabernet Sauvignon) at least 85%.
it-oltrepo-pavese.min_alcohol: Natural potential 9-12.5% by type; total at release 10.5-12.5%, Moscato liquoroso 18%.
it-oltrepo-pavese.styles: Some 36 types: red (also riserva), rosé, white, varietal still, frizzante and spumante wines, Moscato passito and liquoroso.
it-oltrepo-pavese.other: Oltrepò Pavese (province of Pavia). Pinot Grigio, Pinot Nero, Bonarda, Buttafuoco, Sangue di Giuda and Casteggio have their own DOCs; metodo classico is the DOCG.

it-oltrepo-pavese-metodo-classico.ageing: At least 15 months on lees (vintage 24 months) before release.
it-oltrepo-pavese-metodo-classico.styles: Metodo classico white and rosé; Pinot Nero and Pinot Nero rosé; rosé may also be crémant.
it-oltrepo-pavese-metodo-classico.labelling: Vintage optional; Millesimato only with a vintage. Rosé wines may only use rosé, not other colour terms.
it-oltrepo-pavese-metodo-classico.sweetness: Sugar term mandatory up to demi-sec; dolce banned.

it-buttafuoco-dell-oltrepo-pavese.varieties: Barbera 25-65%, Croatina 25-65%, Uva Rara and Vespolina up to 45%.
it-buttafuoco-dell-oltrepo-pavese.release: Not before 30 April of the year after harvest.
it-buttafuoco-dell-oltrepo-pavese.labelling: Buttafuoco dell'Oltrepò Pavese or Buttafuoco; vintage mandatory.

src.title: MASAF, disciplinare di produzione "Buttafuoco dell'Oltrepò Pavese o Buttafuoco" (last amended 07.03.2014)

it-sangue-di-giuda.varieties: Barbera 25-65%, Croatina 25-65%, Uva Rara, Vespolina and Pinot Nero up to 45%.
it-sangue-di-giuda.styles: Sweet or medium-sweet red, still, frizzante or spumante.
it-sangue-di-giuda.labelling: Sangue di Giuda dell'Oltrepò Pavese or Sangue di Giuda; vintage mandatory.

it-casteggio.varieties: Barbera at least 65%; Croatina, Uva Rara, Vespolina, Pinot Nero up to 35%.
it-casteggio.ageing: At least 24 months from 1 November incl. 12 in oak and 6 in bottle; riserva at least 3 years.

src.title: MASAF, disciplinare di produzione "Casteggio" (last amended 07.03.2014)

it-terre-del-colleoni.varieties: Varietal wines at least 85%: Pinot Bianco, Pinot Grigio, Chardonnay, Incrocio Manzoni, Moscato Giallo, Schiava, Merlot, Marzemino, Cabernet, Franconia, Incrocio Terzi.
it-terre-del-colleoni.min_alcohol: Natural potential 9.5% whites, 10% reds; total at release 11%; Moscato Giallo passito 16% with at least 50 g/l sugar.
it-terre-del-colleoni.ageing: Spumante metodo classico at least 15 months on lees (Millesimato 24); passito grapes dried at least 45 days.
it-terre-del-colleoni.styles: Varietal whites and reds, spumante, frizzante, novello (carbonic maceration), Moscato Giallo passito.

src.title: Disciplinare di produzione "Terre del Colleoni o Colleoni" (last amended 11.06.2014), AIS Italia archive copy (Jan 2025)

it-valcalepio.varieties: Rosso: Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon (since 2025 Cabernet Sauvignon from 10% and Merlot up to 90%, plus up to 15% Franconia, Incrocio Terzi, Merera, Rebo or Petit Verdot). Bianco: Pinot Bianco and/or Chardonnay 55-80%, Pinot Grigio 20-45%. Moscato passito: Moscato di Scanzo and/or Moscato.
it-valcalepio.min_alcohol: Natural potential 11% (rosso riserva 12%); Moscato passito 17% total after at least 21 days drying.
it-valcalepio.max_yield: Bianco 9 t/ha, rosso 10 t/ha, Moscato passito 6.5 t/ha; wine 70% (passito 40%).
it-valcalepio.ageing: Rosso at least 1 year incl. 3 months in wood from 1 November; Riserva 3 years incl. 1 in oak.
it-valcalepio.release: Moscato passito not before 12 May of the second year after harvest.
it-valcalepio.other: 2025 amendment (EU notice C/2025/5641) made Riserva a specific type and changed the rosso blend.

src.title: Disciplinare di produzione "Valcalepio" (last amended 07.03.2014), AIS Italia archive copy (Jan 2025)

Official Journal C, C/2025/5641, 20.10.2025 (latest EU amendment notice, 2025-10-20)

it-franciacorta.varieties: Franciacorta and Rosé: Chardonnay and/or Pinot Nero, with Pinot Bianco up to 50% and Erbamat up to 10% (Rosé: Pinot Nero at least 35%). Satèn: Chardonnay at least 50%, Pinot Bianco up to 50%.
it-franciacorta.min_alcohol: Natural potential 9.5% (Erbamat 9%); actual at release at least 11.5%.
it-franciacorta.max_yield: 10 t/ha (2024; up to 12 t/ha in good years as blocked harvest reserve); base wine 65%, at most 6,500 l/ha.
it-franciacorta.ageing: On lees from tirage: Franciacorta 18 months, Rosé and Satèn 24, Millesimato 30, Riserva 60. Tirage from 1 February after the harvest. Vintage and Riserva need at least 85% of the stated year.
it-franciacorta.styles: Bottle-fermented sparkling only: Franciacorta, Satèn (blanc de blancs style, at most 5 atm, at most 20 g/l tirage sugar), Rosé; each also Millesimato and Riserva.
it-franciacorta.labelling: The word Franciacorta alone names method and place; type and sweetness terms no larger than the name.
it-franciacorta.sweetness: Dosaggio zero, extra brut, brut, extra dry, sec, demi-sec.
it-franciacorta.other: DOCG 1995. 2024 amendment (EU notice C/2024/5690) cut yields, removed the altitude limit and set the harvest-reserve system.

src.title: MASAF, disciplinare di produzione "Franciacorta" (last amended 07.05.2024)

Official Journal C, C/2024/5690, 24.9.2024 (latest EU amendment notice, 2024-09-24)

it-curtefranca.varieties: Bianco: Chardonnay at least 50%, Pinot Bianco and/or Pinot Nero up to 50%. Rosso: Cabernet Franc and/or Carmenère at least 20%, Merlot at least 25%, Cabernet Sauvignon 10-35%.
it-curtefranca.ageing: Vigna wines: bianco 3 months in bottle; rosso 8 months in wood plus 6 in bottle.
it-curtefranca.release: Bianco from 1 February; bianco vigna 1 September of the year after harvest; rosso 1 July of the year after; rosso vigna 1 September of the second year after harvest.
it-curtefranca.styles: Still white and red of the Franciacorta zone.
it-curtefranca.other: Formerly Terre di Franciacorta. 2024 amendment cut the white yield from 11 to 10 t/ha.

it-lugana.varieties: Turbiana (Trebbiano di Soave, Trebbiano di Lugana) at least 90%.
it-lugana.min_alcohol: Natural potential 10.5% (Superiore 11.5%, Vendemmia Tardiva 13%); total at release 11-13%.
it-lugana.ageing: Superiore at least 12 months from 1 October of the harvest year; Riserva at least 24 months incl. 6 in bottle; Vendemmia Tardiva at least 12 months.
it-lugana.release: Lugana after 15 January of the year after harvest.
it-lugana.styles: Dry white, Superiore, Riserva, Vendemmia Tardiva, spumante.
it-lugana.labelling: Superiore, Riserva and Vendemmia Tardiva printed directly below DOC and no larger than Lugana.
it-lugana.other: Straddles Lombardy (Brescia) and Veneto (Verona) at the south end of Lake Garda.

it-garda-colli-mantovani.max_yield: Wine 98 hl/ha (bianco), 91 hl/ha (rosso, Chiaretto), 70 hl/ha (rosso superiore, vendemmia tardiva), 45.5 hl/ha (bianco passito).
it-garda-colli-mantovani.ageing: Riserva: rosso 2 years incl. 6 months in bottle, bianco 1 year, from 1 November. Rosso superiore and bianco passito may use dried grapes.

it-san-colombano-al-lambro.varieties: Rosso: Croatina 30-50%, Barbera 25-50%, Uva Rara up to 15%. Bianco: Chardonnay at least 50%, Pinot Nero at least 10%.
it-san-colombano-al-lambro.max_yield: 11 t/ha (rosso riserva vigna 10 t/ha); wine 70%, 77 hl/ha.
it-san-colombano-al-lambro.styles: Red and white, still or frizzante; rosso riserva with vigna.
it-san-colombano-al-lambro.labelling: San Colombano al Lambro or San Colombano. Vintage mandatory; vigna allowed.
it-san-colombano-al-lambro.other: Hills of San Colombano al Lambro (Milan) with parts of the Lodi and Pavia provinces.

it-cellatica.max_yield: 11.5 t/ha (superiore 10 t/ha), max 6 kg per vine; wine 70%.
it-cellatica.release: Superiore after 30 September of the year after harvest.

it-capriano-del-colle.varieties: Rosso, novello, riserva: Marzemino at least 40%, Merlot at least 20%, Sangiovese at least 10%. Marzemino: 100%. Bianco and Trebbiano: Trebbiano di Soave/di Lugana and/or Toscano at least 60%.
it-capriano-del-colle.ageing: Superiore at least 12 months; riserva at least 24 months (wood optional). Novello with at least 60% carbonic maceration.
it-capriano-del-colle.styles: White (also superiore, frizzante), Trebbiano, red (also novello, riserva), Marzemino.

it-scanzo.max_yield: 7 t/ha; wine at most 30% of grapes. No irrigation.
it-scanzo.ageing: Grapes dried at least 21 days to at least 280 g/l sugar; at least 2 years of ageing, without wooden containers (2025).
it-scanzo.release: From 1 November of the second year after harvest.
it-scanzo.labelling: Scanzo or Moscato di Scanzo; vintage mandatory.
it-scanzo.other: Made only in the commune of Scanzorosciate (Bergamo); DOCG 2009. 2025 amendment (EU notice C/2025/6717) banned wood and set volatile acidity at most 25 meq/l.

it-trentino.varieties: Varietal wines at least 85% of the named grape (Chardonnay, Kerner, Manzoni Bianco, Moscato Giallo, Müller Thurgau, Nosiola, Pinot Bianco, Pinot Grigio, Riesling Italico, Riesling Renano, Sauvignon, Traminer Aromatico; Moscato Rosa, Cabernets, Lagrein, Marzemino, Merlot, Pinot Nero, Rebo, Schiava). Bianco: Chardonnay and/or Pinot Bianco at least 80%. Rosso: Cabernets and Merlot. Kretzer/rosato: Enantio, Schiava, Teroldego, Lagrein (at least two, each max 70%). Vino Santo: Nosiola at least 85%.
it-trentino.min_alcohol: Natural potential 9.5-11% by variety (Moscato Rosa 15%; Vino Santo 16% after drying); total at release mostly 10.5-12%.
it-trentino.max_yield: 12-15 t/ha for most varieties (84-105 hl/ha); Cabernets and Marzemino 13 t/ha; Pinot Nero 12 t/ha; Moscato Rosa 8 t/ha (48 hl/ha); Vino Santo 14 t/ha but 30% wine (42 hl/ha).
it-trentino.ageing: Vino Santo: grapes dried on racks by natural methods, pressed not before 1 February after the harvest; released from 1 November of the third year after harvest. Riserva and superiore types need 0.5% more natural alcohol and longer ageing.
it-trentino.styles: Still varietal whites and reds, bianco and rosso blends, kretzer (rosé), Moscato Giallo and Moscato Rosa (also liquoroso), Vino Santo (sweet passito).
it-trentino.other: Province of Trento; Trento DOC covers the sparkling wines.

it-trento.varieties: Chardonnay, Pinot Bianco, Pinot Nero and/or Meunier.
it-trento.ageing: Bottle-fermented (metodo classico) only; at least 15 months on lees; vintage-dated at least 24 months; Riserva at least 36 months.
it-trento.styles: White and rosé metodo classico spumante.
it-trento.labelling: Riserva requires a vintage on the label.
it-trento.other: All winemaking, sparkling elaboration and packaging inside the province of Trento.

it-alto-adige.varieties: Varietal wines at least 85% of the named grape; two-variety reds (Cabernet-Merlot, Cabernet-Lagrein, Merlot-Lagrein) each over 15%. Bianco/Weiß without varietal name. Spumante: Pinot Bianco, Pinot Nero and/or Chardonnay (rosé at least 20% Pinot Nero). Subzone wines with their own rules (Santa Maddalena, Colli di Bolzano and Meranese: Schiava at least 85%).
it-alto-adige.min_alcohol: Natural potential 9.5% (Schiava) to 11% (Lagrein, Pinot Nero, Sauvignon, Gewürztraminer); passito at least 16%.
it-alto-adige.max_yield: Without UGA: Chardonnay, Pinot Bianco, Pinot Grigio, Müller Thurgau 13,000 kg/ha; Lagrein and Schiava 14,000; Gewürztraminer 12,000; Cabernet 11,000; Bianco and Rosso 10,000 kg/ha. With an additional geographical unit (UGA) lower: e.g. 9,800 (Chardonnay, Pinot Bianco), 10,500 (Lagrein, Schiava), 9,000 (Gewürztraminer) kg/ha. Passito at most 40 hl/ha.
it-alto-adige.ageing: Riserva at least 2 years. Spumante without varietal name: metodo classico, at least 15 months in bottle and released no earlier than 20 months from 1 October of the youngest harvest. Passito released from 1 June of the year after harvest.
it-alto-adige.styles: Some 60 types: varietal whites and reds, Bianco, Rosso (added 2025), rosato/kretzer, spumante (incl. Pinot Nero rosato, 2025), passito, vendemmia tardiva, Riserva.
it-alto-adige.labelling: Bilingual Alto Adige / Südtirol (Südtiroler). Subzones Colli di Bolzano/Bozner Leiten, Meranese (di Collina)/Meraner, Santa Maddalena/St. Magdalener (Classico area), Terlano/Terlaner, Valle Isarco/Eisacktal, Valle Venosta/Vinschgau. Since the 2025 amendment 86 additional geographical units (UGA), shown with a dedicated pictogram, replaced the old optional locality names.
it-alto-adige.other: Major 2025 revision: EU notice C/2025/1718 (zone extensions, new types, Riserva for more varieties, 86 UGAs).

it-lago-di-caldaro.varieties: Schiava Grossa, Schiava Gentile and/or Schiava Grigia at least 85%.
it-lago-di-caldaro.labelling: Lago di Caldaro or Caldaro (Kalterersee, Kalterer). Classico (klassisches Ursprungsgebiet) for the core communes around the lake; scelto/Auslese and classico superiore with higher strengths.
it-lago-di-caldaro.other: Straddles the provinces of Bolzano and Trento.

it-valdadige.styles: White, red, rosé, varietal wines; frizzante from Chardonnay and Pinot Bianco by natural refermentation.
it-valdadige.sweetness: Whites at most 6 g/l residual sugar.
it-valdadige.other: Interregional DOC along the Adige valley (Verona, Trento, Bolzano); area extended in 2023.

it-valdadige-terradeiforti.varieties: Enantio at least 85%; Casetta at least 85%; Pinot Grigio at least 85%.
it-valdadige-terradeiforti.min_alcohol: Natural potential 11.5% (Enantio, Casetta), 10-10.5% (Pinot Grigio); total at release 11-12%.
it-valdadige-terradeiforti.max_yield: Enantio and Casetta 9 t/ha (63 hl/ha); Pinot Grigio 14 t/ha (superiore 12 t/ha).
it-valdadige-terradeiforti.ageing: Enantio and Casetta 10 months, riserva 36 months; Pinot Grigio 4 months, superiore 10 months; from 1 November.
it-valdadige-terradeiforti.styles: Enantio and Casetta reds (also riserva); Pinot Grigio (also superiore).
it-valdadige-terradeiforti.labelling: Valdadige Terradeiforti or Terradeiforti. Vintage mandatory.
it-valdadige-terradeiforti.other: Native Enantio (Lambrusco a foglia frastagliata) and Casetta, between Verona and Trento provinces.

it-friuli.varieties: Varietal wines from the named grape (Chardonnay, Friulano, Malvasia Istriana, Pinot Bianco, Pinot Grigio, Riesling, Sauvignon, Traminer Aromatico, Verduzzo Friulano; Cabernet, Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Pinot Nero, Refosco dal Peduncolo Rosso). Bianco and Rosso from the listed varieties. Spumante from Chardonnay, Pinot Bianco, Pinot Grigio, Pinot Nero; Ribolla Gialla spumante at least 85% Ribolla Gialla.
it-friuli.max_yield: 12-14 t/ha (most types 14 t/ha; Malvasia 12 t/ha); wine 75% for whites, 70% for reds, 65% for spumante.
it-friuli.ageing: Tank-method spumante at least 90 days on lees (30 days with stirrers); vintage tank spumante at least 18 months of elaboration and released 24 months after harvest. Metodo classico: tirage from 1 February after harvest, at least 9 months on lees plus 9 in bottle, released at least 25 months later; vintage at least 30 months in bottle and released 37 months after harvest.
it-friuli.styles: Still varietal whites and reds, Bianco, Rosso, Spumante and Ribolla Gialla spumante (tank or metodo classico).
it-friuli.labelling: Friuli or Friuli Venezia Giulia (Slovenian Furlanija, Furlanija Julijska krajina). Superiore, vecchio and similar terms banned.
it-friuli.other: Region-wide DOC registered in 2020 (Reg. (EU) L 379 of 13.11.2020); sparkling elaboration also allowed in Treviso, Venice and Dobrovo (Slovenia).

Bianco and Rosso from listed varieties.
it-friuli-grave.styles: Varietal still wines, Bianco, Rosso, Rosato, Novello; frizzante (Chardonnay, Pinot Bianco, Verduzzo, Rosato); spumante (Chardonnay, Pinot Bianco, Pinot Nero).
it-friuli-grave.labelling: Friuli Grave (the name Friuli must be followed by Grave). Superiore and riserva allowed.
it-friuli-grave.sweetness: Frizzante Verduzzo 10-40 g/l sugar; other frizzanti at most 10 g/l. Spumante extra brut to demi-sec.

it-friuli-colli-orientali.varieties: Varietal wines at least 85% of the named grape: Chardonnay, Malvasia, Pinot Bianco, Pinot Grigio (also ramato, 2026), Ribolla Gialla, Riesling, Sauvignon, Friulano, Traminer Aromatico, Verduzzo Friulano, Cabernet, Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Pignolo, Pinot Nero, Refosco dal Peduncolo Rosso, Schioppettino, Tazzelenghe; Refosco (nostrano) only for Refosco di Faedis. Bianco, Rosso, Dolce.
it-friuli-colli-orientali.min_alcohol: Natural potential 10%; total at release 11% (12% for some types).
it-friuli-colli-orientali.ageing: Riserva at least 2 years from 1 November; Pignolo Riserva at least 4 years.
it-friuli-colli-orientali.styles: Dry varietal whites and reds, Bianco, Rosso, Dolce (sweet, e.g. Verduzzo).
it-friuli-colli-orientali.labelling: Friuli Colli Orientali. Subzones Cialla, Ribolla Gialla di Rosazzo, Pignolo di Rosazzo, Schioppettino di Prepotto, Savorgnano, Refosco di Faedis. Riserva after the variety, no larger. Vintage mandatory.
it-friuli-colli-orientali.other: Friuli Venezia Giulia. Province of Udine. 2026 amendment (EU notice C/2026/988): Pinot Grigio ramato added, minimum density 3,500 vines/ha.

it-colli-orientali-del-friuli-picolit.styles: Sweet white (often from partially dried grapes).
it-colli-orientali-del-friuli-picolit.labelling: Riserva, superiore, classico and similar banned; vintage mandatory; traditional bottles up to 5 l, natural cork. Subzone Cialla.

it-rosazzo.varieties: Friulano at least 50%; Sauvignon 20-30%; Pinot Bianco and/or Chardonnay 20-30%; Ribolla Gialla up to 10%; other whites up to 5%.
it-rosazzo.max_yield: 8 t/ha, 56 hl/ha; max 2 kg per vine in new plantings (at least 4,000 vines/ha).
it-rosazzo.release: From 1 April of the second year after harvest.
it-rosazzo.other: Friuli Venezia Giulia. DOCG 2011, around the Abbey of Rosazzo (Manzano, Corno di Rosazzo, San Giovanni al Natisone).

it-friuli-isonzo.varieties: Varietal wines from the named grape: Chardonnay, Malvasia, Moscato Giallo, Pinot Bianco, Pinot Grigio, Riesling, Riesling Italico, Sauvignon, Friulano, Traminer, Verduzzo; Cabernets, Franconia, Merlot, Moscato Rosa, Pignolo, Pinot Nero, Refosco, Schioppettino. Bianco, Rosso, Rosato, Vendemmia tardiva.
it-friuli-isonzo.min_alcohol: Total at release 10.5-12% (vendemmia tardiva grapes at least 13% natural, wine 13.5%).
it-friuli-isonzo.max_yield: 13 t/ha (91 hl/ha) for Friulano, Malvasia, Verduzzo, Merlot; 12 t/ha (84 hl/ha) for others; max 3.7-4 kg per vine.
it-friuli-isonzo.ageing: Vendemmia tardiva: grapes dried on the vine, picked at least 30 days after harvest starts; wine yield at most 60%.
it-friuli-isonzo.styles: Varietal still wines, frizzante, spumante (elaborated in the Tre Venezie), vendemmia tardiva.
it-friuli-isonzo.labelling: Friuli Isonzo or Isonzo del Friuli.

src.title: MASAF, disciplinare di produzione "Friuli Isonzo o Isonzo del Friuli" (last amended 07.03.2014)

it-friuli-latisana.varieties: Varietal wines at least 85% (Merlot, Cabernets, Carmenère, Franconia, Refosco, Pinot Nero, Pinot Bianco, Pinot Grigio, Friulano, Verduzzo, Traminer, Sauvignon, Chardonnay, Malvasia, Riesling). Bianco: Friulano at least 60%. Rosso/Rosato: Merlot at least 60%.
it-friuli-latisana.max_yield: 12-13 t/ha (superiore and riserva 10 t/ha; passito 11 t/ha); wine 70% (passito 45%).
it-friuli-latisana.ageing: Riserva at least 24 months from 11 November.
it-friuli-latisana.styles: Varietal wines (also superiore, riserva, novello), frizzante, spumante, passito.

src.title: MASAF, disciplinare di produzione "Friuli Latisana" (last amended 07.03.2014)

it-friuli-aquileia.varieties: Varietal wines from the named grape (Merlot, Cabernets, Refosco, Friulano, Pinot Bianco, Pinot Grigio, Riesling, Sauvignon, Traminer, Chardonnay, Verduzzo, Malvasia, Müller Thurgau). Bianco: Friulano at least 50%.
it-friuli-aquileia.max_yield: 13 t/ha whites, 12 t/ha reds, 10 t/ha Traminer; wine 70%.
it-friuli-aquileia.styles: Varietal still wines, Bianco, Rosso, Rosato; frizzante (max 20 g/l sugar); Chardonnay spumante.
it-friuli-aquileia.labelling: Friuli Aquileia, with Aquileia directly below the DOC term.

src.title: MASAF, disciplinare di produzione "Friuli Aquileia" (last amended 07.03.2014)

it-friuli-annia.varieties: Varietal wines at least 90% (Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon, Refosco, Friulano, Pinot Bianco, Pinot Grigio, Verduzzo, Traminer, Sauvignon, Chardonnay, Malvasia). Bianco and Rosso from non-aromatic listed varieties.
it-friuli-annia.styles: White, red, rosé, varietal; frizzante and spumante.

src.title: MASAF, disciplinare di produzione "Friuli Annia" (last amended 07.03.2014)

it-carso.varieties: Carso (Rosso): Terrano at least 70%. Varietal wines at least 85%: Chardonnay, Glera, Malvasia Istriana, Pinot Grigio, Sauvignon, Traminer, Vitovska, Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Refosco, Terrano.

it-carso.labelling: Carso or Carso-Kras; Terrano Classico for the historic core. Vintage mandatory.

it-alto-adige-terlano.styles: Dry whites, also passito, vendemmia tardiva and riserva; Müller Thurgau riserva since 2025.
it-alto-adige-terlano.labelling: Terlano or Terlaner; Classico for the historic core.
it-alto-adige-terlano.other: Subzone (sottozona) of the Alto Adige / Südtirol DOC. 2025 amendment (EU C/2025/1718) added Riserva for several subzone types.

it-alto-adige-valle-isarco.other: Subzone (sottozona) of the Alto Adige / Südtirol DOC. Area extended to San Osvaldo (Castelrotto) in 2025.

it-prosecco.varieties: Glera at least 85%; Verdiso, Bianchetta Trevigiana, Perera, Glera Lunga, Chardonnay, Pinot Bianco, Pinot Grigio, Pinot Nero (white-vinified) up to 15%. Spumante rosé: Glera 85-90% plus Pinot Nero (red-vinified) 10-15%.
it-prosecco.min_alcohol: Natural potential 9.5% still, 9% spumante and frizzante; total at release 10.5% (still, frizzante), 11% (spumante, rosé).
it-prosecco.max_yield: 18 t/ha (Pinot Nero for rosé 13.5 t/ha); wine 75%.
it-prosecco.ageing: Spumante by tank (autoclave) fermentation only; rosé at least 60 days of elaboration. Frizzante by tank or bottle refermentation (rifermentazione in bottiglia, may be cloudy).
it-prosecco.release: Spumante, rosé and frizzante not before 1 January after the harvest (regions may bring this forward by up to 3 months).
it-prosecco.styles: Spumante (brut nature to demi-sec), spumante rosé (brut nature to extra dry), frizzante, still.
it-prosecco.labelling: Provincia di Treviso/Treviso or Provincia di Trieste/Trieste (Trst) only if all grapes come from that province. Millesimato needs at least 85% of the vintage; rosé must be Millesimato with the year. Other place names banned.
it-prosecco.sweetness: Spumante: brut nature, extra brut, brut, extra dry, dry, demi-sec. Rosé: brut nature to extra dry.
it-prosecco.other: Nine provinces in Veneto and Friuli Venezia Giulia. 2025 amendment (EU notice C/2025/6773) allows the 15% Pinot/Chardonnay addition for frizzante and restricts expedition-liqueur ingredients.

it-conegliano-valdobbiadene-prosecco.min_alcohol: Natural potential 9.5% (spumante and frizzante 9%); total at release 10.5-11.5%.

it-conegliano-valdobbiadene-prosecco.styles: Spumante Superiore (extra brut to demi-sec), frizzante (secco to amabile), still; spumante sui lieviti (bottle-refermented, brut nature only).
it-conegliano-valdobbiadene-prosecco.labelling: Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco, or Conegliano Prosecco or Valdobbiadene Prosecco; for spumante Prosecco and Superiore may be omitted. Rive followed by one of 43 additional geographical units (vintage mandatory); Superiore di Cartizze (Valdobbiadene). Sui lieviti may not be combined with Millesimato or Rive.

it-corti-benedettine-del-padovano.ageing: Moscato passito grapes not pressed before 31 December, at least 270 g/l sugar; Raboso passito at least 235 g/l.

it-corti-benedettine-del-padovano.labelling: Vintage mandatory for riserva, novello and passito.

it-amarone-della-valpolicella.varieties: Corvina (Corvina Veronese) and/or Corvinone 45-95%; Rondinella 5-30%; up to 25% other red varieties (max 15% non-aromatic Verona varieties, each max 10%, plus up to 10% Italian native red varieties).
it-amarone-della-valpolicella.min_alcohol: Natural potential 11% at harvest; actual at release at least 14%.
it-amarone-della-valpolicella.max_yield: 12 t/ha, of which at most 65% (about 7.8 t/ha) may be set aside for drying; wine at most 40% of the fresh grapes.
it-amarone-della-valpolicella.ageing: Grapes dried (appassimento) and not vinified before 1 December (earlier only by regional derogation). At least 2 years from 1 January after the harvest; Riserva at least 4 years from 1 November of the harvest year.
it-amarone-della-valpolicella.styles: Dry red from dried grapes; Riserva.
it-amarone-della-valpolicella.labelling: Classico for the historic zone and Valpantena for that valley; vigna with a place name allowed. Vintage mandatory.
it-amarone-della-valpolicella.sweetness: Residual sugar at most 9 g/l at 14% actual alcohol, plus 0.1 g/l per 0.1% above 14% up to 16%, and 0.15 g/l per 0.1% above 16%.
it-amarone-della-valpolicella.other: Province of Verona. DOCG since 2010. Last amended by DM 03.08.2023.

src.title: MASAF, disciplinare di produzione "Amarone della Valpolicella" (last amended 03.08.2023)

it-recioto-della-valpolicella.varieties: Corvina (Corvina Veronese) and/or Corvinone 45-95%; Rondinella 5-30%; up to 25% other red varieties (max 15% non-aromatic Verona varieties, each max 10%, plus up to 10% Italian native red varieties).
it-recioto-della-valpolicella.min_alcohol: Natural potential 11% at harvest; actual at release at least 12% with at least 2.8% potential (residual sugar).
it-recioto-della-valpolicella.max_yield: 12 t/ha, of which at most 65% may be set aside for drying; wine at most 40% of the fresh grapes.
it-recioto-della-valpolicella.ageing: Dried grapes not vinified before 1 December.
it-recioto-della-valpolicella.styles: Sweet red from dried grapes; Recioto spumante (sweet sparkling).
it-recioto-della-valpolicella.labelling: Classico for the historic zone and Valpantena for that valley; vigna with a place name allowed.

it-valpolicella.varieties: Corvina (Corvina Veronese) and/or Corvinone 45-95%; Rondinella 5-30%; up to 25% other red varieties (max 15% non-aromatic Verona varieties, each max 10%, plus up to 10% Italian native red varieties).
it-valpolicella.min_alcohol: Natural potential 10% (Superiore 11%); actual at release 11% (Superiore 12%), max 0.4% potential.
it-valpolicella.ageing: Superiore at least 1 year from 1 January after the harvest.
it-valpolicella.labelling: Classico for the historic zone and Valpantena for that valley; vigna with a place name allowed.
it-valpolicella.other: Bottling must take place in the vinification zone.

it-valpolicella-ripasso.varieties: Corvina (Corvina Veronese) and/or Corvinone 45-95%; Rondinella 5-30%; up to 25% other red varieties (max 15% non-aromatic Verona varieties, each max 10%, plus up to 10% Italian native red varieties).
it-valpolicella-ripasso.min_alcohol: Base wine at least 11.5% total (Superiore 12.5%); actual at release 12.5% (Superiore 13%), max 0.6% potential.
it-valpolicella-ripasso.max_yield: 12 t/ha; base wine 70% (84 hl/ha); finished wine at most 71.8 hl/ha.
it-valpolicella-ripasso.ageing: Made by a single refermentation of Valpolicella on the pomace of Amarone and/or Recioto (pomace at least 0.5% potential alcohol, contributing 10-15% of volume); at most twice the volume of Amarone/Recioto produced; ripasso lasts at least 3 days.
it-valpolicella-ripasso.release: Not before 1 January of the second year after harvest.
it-valpolicella-ripasso.labelling: Classico for the historic zone and Valpantena for that valley; vigna with a place name allowed. Vigna only for Superiore.
it-valpolicella-ripasso.other: DOC since 2010 (previously a method within Valpolicella).

it-colli-berici.varieties: Varietal wines at least 85% (Tai, Garganega, Sauvignon, Pinot Bianco, Pinot Nero, Pinot Grigio, Chardonnay, Manzoni Bianco, Merlot, Tai Rosso, Cabernets, Carmenère). Bianco: Garganega 30-60%, Sauvignon 20-50%. Spumante metodo classico: Chardonnay at least 50%.
it-colli-berici.min_alcohol: Natural potential 9.5-12% by type; riserva reds +2% natural.
it-colli-berici.max_yield: Rosso 15 t/ha (superiore 13.5, riserva 12.5); bianco 16 t/ha (superiore 14); wine 70%.
it-colli-berici.ageing: Metodo classico at least 15 months on lees (vintage 30 months, at least 85% of the year).
it-colli-berici.styles: White, red (also superiore, riserva), Tai Rosso, Barbarano (Tai Rosso) subzone, metodo classico spumante (also rosé), passito.

it-lessini-durello.styles: Tank-method (Martinotti/charmat) spumante only since 2024 (the metodo classico type moved to Monti Lessini).
it-lessini-durello.labelling: Lessini Durello or Durello Lessini; vigna allowed.

it-monti-lessini.max_yield: Durella 16 t/ha; Pinot Nero and Bianco 12 t/ha; wine 70% (passito 40%).
it-monti-lessini.ageing: Spumante metodo classico only, at least 18 months on lees (longer for riserva). Passito grapes dried at least 2 months.
it-monti-lessini.styles: Metodo classico spumante (also riserva and crémant), Durello still and passito, Pinot Nero, Bianco.

it-colli-di-conegliano.min_alcohol: Total at release 12% (bianco), 12.5% (rosso), 15% (Refrontolo passito), 18% (Torchiato di Fregona).

it-colli-di-conegliano.ageing: Torchiato di Fregona grapes dried at least 150 days to 18% potential.
it-colli-di-conegliano.styles: White, red (also riserva), Refrontolo (also passito), Torchiato di Fregona (sweet).
it-colli-di-conegliano.labelling: Refrontolo and Torchiato di Fregona printed below DOCG and no larger than the denomination.

it-arcole.varieties: Varietal Pinot Grigio, Chardonnay, Garganega, Merlot at least 85%. Bianco: Garganega at least 50%. Rosso, rosato, Nero: Merlot at least 50%.
it-arcole.max_yield: Garganega and Chardonnay 18 t/ha, Merlot and reds 16 t/ha, Pinot Grigio 15 t/ha (superiore 13 t/ha); wine 70%.
it-arcole.ageing: Riserva (rosso, Merlot, Nero) at least 2 years. Passito grapes dried at least 2 months.
it-arcole.styles: Bianco (also passito, frizzante, spumante), rosso, rosato, Nero, Pinot Grigio (also rosato and superiore), Garganega, Chardonnay, Merlot.

it-bardolino.release: Bardolino and Bardolino Classico from 15 January after the harvest; Novello bottled by 31 December (100% carbonic maceration).
it-bardolino.styles: Light red, Chiaretto (rosé; still and spumante), Novello.
it-bardolino.labelling: Classico for the historic zone. Chiaretto must precede Bardolino, in the same size. Subzones Montebaldo, La Rocca and Sommacampagna (2021). Vintage mandatory except non-vintage spumante.
it-bardolino.sweetness: Residual sugar at most 9 g/l; Chiaretto spumante at most 10 g/l.

it-bardolino-superiore.ageing: At least 1 year from 1 November of the harvest year.

it-colli-euganei.min_alcohol: Total at release 10.5-11%; riserva grapes at least 12% natural.
it-colli-euganei.max_yield: Riserva reds max 9 t/ha and 2 kg per vine; wine 70%.
it-colli-euganei.ageing: Riserva reds at least 24 months from 1 November.

it-colli-euganei.labelling: Vintage mandatory except spumante and frizzante.
it-colli-euganei.sweetness: Whites at most 10 g/l residual sugar.

it-colli-euganei-fior-d-arancio.ageing: Passito at least 1 year from 1 November.
it-colli-euganei-fior-d-arancio.styles: Sweet aromatic white (still), spumante (aromatic sweet sparkling), passito.

it-bianco-di-custoza.release: From 1 December of the harvest year.
it-bianco-di-custoza.styles: Dry white, superiore, riserva, spumante, passito.
it-bianco-di-custoza.labelling: Registered as Custoza (Bianco di Custoza). Vintage mandatory except spumante.
it-bianco-di-custoza.sweetness: Residual sugar at most 7 g/l for the dry types.

it-bagnoli-friularo.max_yield: 12 t/ha (classico 11 t/ha); wine 70% fresh, 45% dried grapes.

it-soave.max_yield: 15 t/ha (Classico and Colli Scaligeri 14 t/ha); wine 70%.

it-merlara.styles: Bianco and Chardonnay (also frizzante), varietal reds and whites, Rosso (also novello with at least 70% carbonic maceration), Marzemino frizzante.

it-romagna.varieties: Sangiovese types at least 85% Sangiovese; Bianco and Trebbiano: Trebbiano Romagnolo at least 70% (Trebbiano type 85%); Rosato: Sangiovese at least 70%; Albana spumante: Albana at least 95%; Cagnina and Pagadebit types.

it-romagna.max_yield: Bianco and Rosato 18 t/ha; Rosso 14; Trebbiano and Pagadebit 14; Cagnina 13; Sangiovese 12; Sangiovese superiore 10.5 t/ha. Wine 70% (rosso 65%, Albana spumante 50%).
it-romagna.ageing: Sangiovese riserva at least 24 months from 1 December of the harvest year.
it-romagna.styles: Sangiovese (also novello, superiore, riserva, passito), Trebbiano (also frizzante, spumante), Bianco, Rosato, Rosso, Cagnina (sweet red), Pagadebit, Albana spumante dolce, bianco and rosato spumante.
it-romagna.labelling: Sangiovese subzones: Bertinoro, Brisighella, Castrocaro, Cesena, Longiano, Meldola, Modigliana, Marzeno, Oriolo, Predappio, Mercato Saraceno, Serra, Imola, Coriano, San Clemente, Verucchio. Vintage mandatory except non-vintage spumante and frizzante.
it-romagna.sweetness: Cagnina has over 60 g/l residual sugar; Albana spumante dolce.
it-romagna.other: New red and white subzone types (incl. Famoso Mercato Saraceno) added in 2022. A Union amendment application to add the quality sparkling wine category was published in April 2026 (EU notice C/2026/2147).

it-rosso-di-montalcino.other: Same 100% Sangiovese base as Brunello from the same commune; screwcaps allowed (Brunello cork only).

it-moscadello-di-montalcino.ageing: Vendemmia tardiva at least 1 year from 1 January after harvest; partial drying of up to 50% of the crop allowed; no enrichment.
it-moscadello-di-montalcino.release: Vendemmia tardiva from 1 January of the second year after harvest.

it-moscadello-di-montalcino.labelling: Vintage mandatory; Riserva, Superiore and similar terms banned; glass bottles only, no crown caps.

it-sant-antimo.varieties: Rosso and bianco: any Tuscan red or white varieties. Varietal Chardonnay, Sauvignon, Pinot Grigio, Pinot Nero, Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot. Vin Santo: Trebbiano Toscano and Malvasia Bianca Lunga at least 70%. Occhio di Pernice: Sangiovese 50-70%, Malvasia Nera 30-50%.
it-sant-antimo.min_alcohol: Total at release 11.5-12%; Vin Santo 16%; novello 11%.
it-sant-antimo.max_yield: 9 t/ha, 63 hl/ha (Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Pinot Nero 8 t/ha, 56 hl/ha); Vin Santo 31.5 hl/ha.
it-sant-antimo.ageing: Vin Santo grapes dried to at least 26.6% sugar, pressed 1 December to 31 March, aged in caratelli of at most 5 hl.
it-sant-antimo.release: Vin Santo from 1 November of the third year after harvest (riserva fourth year).
it-sant-antimo.styles: Red, white, novello, varietal wines, Vin Santo and Occhio di Pernice (also riserva).
it-sant-antimo.other: Catch-all DOC of the Montalcino commune.

src.title: Disciplinare di produzione "Sant'Antimo" (last amended 07.03.2014), AIS Italia archive copy (Jan 2025)

it-valdinievole.varieties: Bianco: Trebbiano Toscano at least 70%. Rosso: Sangiovese at least 35% and Canaiolo Nero at least 20%, together at least 70%. Sangiovese at least 85%.
it-valdinievole.min_alcohol: Natural potential 10-11% (superiore higher); total at release 11-12.5%; Vin Santo 17%.
it-valdinievole.max_yield: Bianco 11.5 t/ha (superiore 10.5); rosso 10 t/ha (superiore 8.5); Vin Santo 35% of grapes.
it-valdinievole.ageing: Vin Santo grapes dried to at least 28% sugar without heated dehumidification.
it-valdinievole.release: Bianco superiore and rosso superiore from 1 March after harvest.
it-valdinievole.styles: White and red (both also superiore), Sangiovese, Vin Santo.
it-valdinievole.labelling: Commune names such as Montecatini Terme, Pescia, Monsummano Terme may appear.
it-valdinievole.other: Governo all'uso toscano allowed for reds.

src.title: Disciplinare di produzione "Valdinievole" (last amended 07.03.2014), AIS Italia archive copy (Jan 2025)
eAmbrosia EU register: Valdinievole PDO (single document, amendments)

it-bianco-dell-empolese.min_alcohol: Natural potential 10%; total at release 11%; Vin Santo 17%.
it-bianco-dell-empolese.ageing: Vin Santo grapes dried to at least 28% sugar, aged in caratelli of at most 5 hl in vinsantaie.
it-bianco-dell-empolese.release: Bianco from 1 December of the harvest year.

src.title: MASAF, disciplinare di produzione "Bianco dell'Empolese" (last amended 07.03.2014)
eAmbrosia EU register: Bianco dell'Empolese PDO (single document, amendments)

it-elba.varieties: Rosso: Sangiovese at least 60%. Bianco and Vin Santo: Trebbiano Toscano 10-70% with Ansonica and/or Vermentino 10-70%. Varietal Sangiovese (Sangioveto), Ansonica, Vermentino, Trebbiano (Procanico) at least 85%.
it-elba.min_alcohol: Natural potential 10-12% depending on type; Vin Santo total 16%.
it-elba.max_yield: Whites 9 t/ha; reds 8 t/ha; passiti 7 t/ha; at least 4,000 vines/ha for new plantings.
it-elba.ageing: Passiti grapes dried at least 10 days to at least 30% sugar. Vin Santo grapes dried to 26.5%, pressed 1 November to 31 March, aged in wood of at most 5 hl.
it-elba.release: Vin Santo from 1 November of the third year after harvest.
it-elba.styles: White, spumante, red (also riserva), rosé, varietal wines, Ansonica passito, Moscato passito, Bianco passito, Vin Santo and Occhio di Pernice.

src.title: MASAF, disciplinare di produzione "Elba" (last amended 07.03.2014)
eAmbrosia EU register: Elba PDO (single document, amendments)

it-elba-aleatico-passito.min_alcohol: Grapes at least 11.5% natural potential at harvest; total at release at least 19%.
it-elba-aleatico-passito.max_yield: 7 t/ha, at most 1.8 kg per vine; wine 35% of fresh grapes.
it-elba-aleatico-passito.ageing: Grapes dried at least 10 days, in air or in rooms, to at least 30% sugar.
it-elba-aleatico-passito.release: From 1 March of the year after harvest.
it-elba-aleatico-passito.labelling: Elba Aleatico Passito or Aleatico Passito dell'Elba.
it-elba-aleatico-passito.other: DOCG since 2011; drying, vinification and bottling on Elba.

eAmbrosia EU register: Elba Aleatico Passito PDO (single document, amendments)

it-parrina.varieties: Rosso and rosato: Sangiovese at least 70% (no Aleatico). Bianco and Vin Santo: Trebbiano Toscano 10-30%, Ansonica 30-50%, Vermentino 20-40%, Chardonnay and Sauvignon up to 20%. Varietal wines at least 85%.
it-parrina.max_yield: Reds 9 t/ha; whites and Vin Santo 10 t/ha; wine 70%.
it-parrina.ageing: Rosso and Sangiovese riserva at least 2 years incl. 1 in wood and 3 months in bottle, from 1 November of the harvest year. Vin Santo grapes dried to at least 26.6% sugar.
it-parrina.release: Reds and rosato from 1 March after harvest; whites from 31 December of the harvest year.
it-parrina.styles: Red and Sangiovese (both also riserva), rosé, Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, white, Vermentino, Chardonnay, Sauvignon, Vin Santo.

it-montecarlo.varieties: Bianco and Vin Santo: Trebbiano Toscano 30-60% with at least three of Sémillon, Pinot Grigio, Pinot Bianco, Vermentino, Sauvignon, Roussanne (40-70%). Rosso: Sangiovese 50-75%; Canaiolo, Merlot, Syrah 15-40%; Ciliegiolo, Colorino, Malvasia Nera, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc 10-30%.
it-montecarlo.min_alcohol: Natural potential 10.5-12%; total at release 11.5-12.5%; Vin Santo 16%.
it-montecarlo.max_yield: Bianco and rosso 10 t/ha; Vermentino, Sauvignon 9 t/ha; Cabernet Sauvignon, Syrah, Merlot 7.5 t/ha; wine 70%, Vin Santo 35%.
it-montecarlo.ageing: Rosso riserva at least 2 years incl. 6 months in bottle from 1 January after harvest. Vin Santo grapes dried to at least 26.6% sugar, aged in caratelli of at most 5 hl.
it-montecarlo.release: Vin Santo from 1 November of the third year after harvest.
it-montecarlo.styles: White, red (also riserva), varietal wines, Vin Santo and Occhio di Pernice.
it-montecarlo.other: Hills east of Lucca; unusual French white varieties (Sémillon, Roussanne) are traditional here.

it-candia-dei-colli-apuani.varieties: Bianco: Vermentino Bianco at least 70%. Vermentino at least 85%. Rosso and rosato: Sangiovese 60-80%, Merlot up to 20%. Vermentino Nero at least 85%. Barsaglina (Massaretta) at least 85%.
it-candia-dei-colli-apuani.min_alcohol: Natural potential 10.5%; total at release 11.5%; Vin Santo 16.5%; vendemmia tardiva 15% natural.
it-candia-dei-colli-apuani.max_yield: 9 t/ha with at least 6,000 vines/ha (1.5 kg per vine); wine 70%; Vin Santo 35%.
it-candia-dei-colli-apuani.ageing: Vin Santo grapes dried to at least 27% sugar, pressed 1 December to 31 March, aged in caratelli of at most 5 hl.
it-candia-dei-colli-apuani.release: Vin Santo from 1 November of the third year after harvest.
it-candia-dei-colli-apuani.styles: White (also frizzante, secco or amabile), Vermentino, red, rosé, Vermentino Nero, Barsaglina, vendemmia tardiva, Vin Santo.
it-candia-dei-colli-apuani.labelling: Vintage mandatory; superiore, riserva and similar terms banned.
it-candia-dei-colli-apuani.sweetness: Amabile types may referment in bottle.
it-candia-dei-colli-apuani.other: Steep terraced hills above Massa and Carrara.

it-rosso-di-montepulciano.varieties: Sangiovese (Prugnolo Gentile) at least 70%; complementary Tuscan varieties up to 30%, white grapes at most 5%; aromatic varieties excluded except Malvasia Bianca Lunga.
it-rosso-di-montepulciano.release: From 1 March of the year after harvest.
it-rosso-di-montepulciano.labelling: Broader term Toscana mandatory on the label (2020).

it-vin-santo-di-montepulciano.varieties: Vin Santo and riserva: Malvasia Bianca, Grechetto Bianco (Pulcinculo), Trebbiano Toscano at least 70%. Occhio di Pernice: Sangiovese (Prugnolo Gentile) at least 50%.
it-vin-santo-di-montepulciano.min_alcohol: Total at release 17% (riserva 20%, Occhio di Pernice 21%).
it-vin-santo-di-montepulciano.max_yield: 10 t/ha (Occhio di Pernice 8 t/ha); wine 35% of fresh grapes.
it-vin-santo-di-montepulciano.ageing: Grapes dried to at least 28% sugar (riserva and Occhio di Pernice 33%). Aged in wood of at most 300 l; riserva in caratelli of at most 125 l; Occhio di Pernice at most 75 l.
it-vin-santo-di-montepulciano.styles: Vin Santo, Vin Santo riserva, Vin Santo Occhio di Pernice.
it-vin-santo-di-montepulciano.labelling: Must read Vin Santo di Montepulciano, DOC, Toscana in that order; Toscana in matching type.
it-vin-santo-di-montepulciano.other: Vinification and ageing in the commune of Montepulciano (some nearby wineries authorised).

it-vino-nobile-di-montepulciano.varieties: Sangiovese (Prugnolo Gentile) at least 70%; up to 30% complementary Tuscan varieties, white grapes at most 5%. Pieve: Sangiovese at least 85%, rest only Canaiolo Nero, Ciliegiolo, Mammolo, Colorino (Colorino max 5%); no international varieties.
it-vino-nobile-di-montepulciano.max_yield: 8 t/ha; wine 70%. Pieve 7 t/ha, at most 2.5 kg per vine, vineyards at least 15 years old.
it-vino-nobile-di-montepulciano.ageing: At least 2 years from 1 January after harvest, with three options: 24 months in wood; at least 18 months in wood; or at least 12 months in wood plus 6 in bottle. Riserva at least 3 years incl. 6 months in bottle. Pieve at least 3 years incl. 12 months in wood and 12 in bottle.
it-vino-nobile-di-montepulciano.labelling: Toscana mandatory on the label (2020). Pieve followed by one of 12 additional geographical units (2025); Pieve cannot be combined with Riserva. Vigna allowed.
it-vino-nobile-di-montepulciano.other: Vinification and ageing in the commune of Montepulciano. Pieve units introduced by EU notice C/2025/2742.

it-terre-di-casole.min_alcohol: Natural potential 10-12%; total at release 11-12.5%; passito 15%.
it-terre-di-casole.max_yield: Bianco 9 t/ha; bianco riserva and rosso 8 t/ha; rosso superiore and Sangiovese 7 t/ha.
it-terre-di-casole.styles: White (also riserva), red (also superiore), Sangiovese (also riserva), passito.
it-terre-di-casole.labelling: Vintage mandatory; Vigna allowed. Superiore needs vines at least 7 years old; Sangiovese riserva at least 8.

it-bolgheri.varieties: Rosso, superiore and rosato: Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc 0-100% each; Syrah and Sangiovese up to 50% each; other red varieties up to 30%. Bianco (2022): Vermentino, Sauvignon, Viognier 0-100% each, others up to 40%. Vermentino and Sauvignon varietals at least 85%.

it-bolgheri.ageing: Rosso superiore at least 2 years from 1 January after harvest, at least 1 year in oak.
it-bolgheri.release: Rosso from 1 September of the year after harvest.
it-bolgheri.styles: Red, red superiore, rosé, white, Vermentino, Sauvignon.
it-bolgheri.labelling: Vigna allowed if listed in the regional register.
it-bolgheri.other: Commune of Castagneto Carducci (Livorno), excluding land west of the old Via Aurelia; at least 4,500 vines/ha for new plantings; expanded training systems banned.

it-bolgheri-sassicaia.varieties: Cabernet Sauvignon at least 80%; other red varieties up to 20%.

it-bolgheri-sassicaia.other: Separate DOC inside the Bolgheri zone (Castagneto Carducci); only spurred cordon or low alberello training.

it-san-gimignano.varieties: Rosso and rosato: Sangiovese at least 50%; Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Syrah, Pinot Nero up to 40%. Varietal Sangiovese, Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Syrah, Pinot Nero at least 85%.
it-san-gimignano.min_alcohol: Natural potential 11.5% reds, 11% rosato, 10% Vin Santo; total at release 12% reds, 11.5% rosato, 16.5% Vin Santo.
it-san-gimignano.max_yield: Reds 8 t/ha; rosato and Vin Santo 10 t/ha; wine 70%; Vin Santo 35%.
it-san-gimignano.ageing: Riserva reds at least 24 months incl. 7 in wood. Vin Santo grapes dried to 27% sugar, fermented and aged in wood of at most 250 l.
it-san-gimignano.styles: Red and varietal reds (also riserva), rosé, Vin Santo and Occhio di Pernice.
it-san-gimignano.labelling: Toscana mandatory on the label (2025 amendment). Vigna allowed.
it-san-gimignano.other: Red and sweet counterpart to Vernaccia; vinification within the provinces of Siena and Florence.

it-vernaccia-di-san-gimignano.varieties: Vernaccia di San Gimignano at least 85%; non-aromatic white varieties up to 15%, Sauvignon and Riesling together at most 10%; Traminer, Moscato Bianco, Müller Thurgau, Malvasia di Candia, Malvasia Istriana, Incrocio Bruni 54 banned.
it-vernaccia-di-san-gimignano.max_yield: 9 t/ha, at most 3 kg per vine for recent plantings; wine 70%.

it-suvereto.varieties: Suvereto (rosso): Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, and since 2025 also Sangiovese, Cabernet Franc, Syrah. Varietal Sangiovese, Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, and new Cabernet Franc and Syrah: 100% since the 2025 amendment.
it-suvereto.ageing: Riserva at least 24 months incl. 12 in wood and 6 in bottle (2025).
it-suvereto.release: From 1 May of the second year after harvest (was 1 June); riserva from 1 January of the third year.
it-suvereto.styles: Dry red and varietal reds; riserva.
it-suvereto.labelling: Toscana mandatory on the label (2025). Vigna allowed.
it-suvereto.other: DOCG since 2011 in the commune of Suvereto (Livorno); 2025 amendment published as EU notice C/2025/6754.

it-pomino.varieties: Bianco: Pinot Bianco, Pinot Grigio, Chardonnay at least 70%. Rosso and Occhio di Pernice: Sangiovese at least 50%, Pinot Nero and Merlot up to 50%. Varietal Pinot Nero, Merlot, Chardonnay, Sauvignon at least 85%.
it-pomino.min_alcohol: Natural potential 9% spumante (riserva 10%), 10% white types, 11% red types; Vin Santo total 15.5%.

it-pomino.ageing: Spumante by bottle fermentation with riddling and disgorgement. Vendemmia tardiva grapes shrivelled on the vine to at least 12% natural.
it-pomino.styles: White, red (both also riserva and vendemmia tardiva), varietal wines, spumante white and rosé (also riserva), Vin Santo and Occhio di Pernice.
it-pomino.labelling: Non-vintage spumante must show the disgorgement year.
it-pomino.other: High hills of Rufina (Florence province); vinification within the province of Florence.

src.title: Disciplinare di produzione "Pomino" (last amended 07.03.2014), AIS Italia archive copy (Jan 2025)
eAmbrosia EU register: Pomino PDO (single document, amendments)

it-barco-reale-di-carmignano.varieties: Sangiovese at least 50%; Canaiolo Nero up to 20%; Cabernet Franc and/or Cabernet Sauvignon 10-20%; Trebbiano, Canaiolo Bianco, Malvasia up to 10%.
it-barco-reale-di-carmignano.other: Younger-drinking wine of the Carmignano zone; can be declassified from Carmignano DOCG at harvest or during its ageing.

src.title: MASAF, disciplinare di produzione "Barco Reale di Carmignano" (last amended 07.03.2014)

it-carmignano.varieties: Sangiovese at least 50%; Canaiolo Nero up to 20%; Cabernet Franc and/or Cabernet Sauvignon 10-20%; Trebbiano Toscano, Canaiolo Bianco, Malvasia up to 10%; other red varieties up to 10%.

it-carmignano.release: From 1 June of the second year after harvest; riserva from 29 September (San Michele) of the third year.
it-carmignano.other: Communes of Carmignano and Poggio a Caiano. Cabernet has been part of the blend by tradition; up to 15% wine of other vintages allowed.

src.title: MASAF, disciplinare di produzione "Carmignano" (last amended 07.03.2014)

it-vin-santo-di-carmignano.varieties: Trebbiano Toscano and Malvasia Bianca Lunga at least 75%. Occhio di Pernice: Sangiovese at least 50%.
it-vin-santo-di-carmignano.max_yield: 10 t/ha; wine 35% of fresh grapes (at the third year of ageing).
it-vin-santo-di-carmignano.ageing: Grapes dried to at least 26.6% sugar, pressed 1 December to 31 March, aged in caratelli of at most 3 hl.
it-vin-santo-di-carmignano.release: From 1 November of the third year after harvest; riserva fourth year.
it-vin-santo-di-carmignano.styles: Vin Santo and Occhio di Pernice (both also riserva).

it-colli-altotiberini.varieties: Bianco: Trebbiano Toscano at least 50%. Bianco superiore and spumante: Grechetto, Chardonnay, Pinot Bianco, Pinot Nero, Pinot Grigio at least 50%. Rosso, rosato, novello: Sangiovese at least 50%. Varietal Grechetto, Trebbiano, Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Sangiovese.

it-colli-altotiberini.ageing: Riserva reds at least 24 months from 1 November of the harvest year. Spumante by tank or bottle fermentation, no added CO2.
it-colli-altotiberini.release: Bianco superiore from 31 March after harvest.
it-colli-altotiberini.styles: White (also superiore, spumante), red (also novello, riserva), rosé, varietal wines.
it-colli-altotiberini.labelling: Vintage mandatory for riserva, superiore and aged types.
it-colli-altotiberini.other: Upper Tiber valley around Città di Castello (Perugia).

src.title: MASAF, disciplinare di produzione "Colli Altotiberini" (last amended 07.03.2014)

it-malvasia-di-bosa.max_yield: 6 t/ha (spumante 8 t/ha); wine 70% (passito 50%); at least 4,000 vines/ha.
it-malvasia-di-bosa.ageing: Riserva at least 2 years incl. 1 in wood from 1 November. Passito grapes dried to at least 272 g/l.
it-malvasia-di-bosa.release: Amabile and dolce from 1 March after harvest; spumante from 1 November of the harvest year; passito from April after harvest.
it-malvasia-di-bosa.styles: Malvasia (secco to dolce), riserva, spumante, passito.
it-malvasia-di-bosa.labelling: Vintage mandatory except spumante; Vigna allowed.

it-moscato-di-sorso.min_alcohol: Natural potential 14%; total at release 14.5-21% (passito 16%, liquoroso 21%).
it-moscato-di-sorso.release: Spumante from 1 November of the harvest year; bianco from 1 March; liquoroso and passito from 1 June after harvest.
it-moscato-di-sorso.styles: Sweet Moscato bianco, liquoroso, passito, spumante.
it-moscato-di-sorso.labelling: Moscato di Sorso-Sennori, Moscato di Sorso or Moscato di Sennori. Vintage mandatory except liquoroso and spumante.
